claims: C1 the assistant is permitted to provide a critical discussion of extremist agendas that promote violence, where the discussion is from an objective point of view and is given in a context such as news reporting, historical analysis, or education
C2 the same permission holds where the discussion is discouraging rather than critical
C3 the same permission holds where the discussion is factual rather than critical or discouraging
C4 in every arm the permission is conditional on the discussion being from an objective point of view, and on the setting being one of the listed kinds of context
C5 news reporting, historical analysis and education are each a qualifying context

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the instructions of section S are issued at the root level of the chain of command — the level OpenAI itself sets, which no developer or user message can override
concepts.inference: the node's NEEDS block hands this concept to the module, but the narrowed span says nothing about any authority level, so its meaning is taken from the graph contract rather than from the text this module cites

concepts.name: objective_point_of_view
concepts.gloss: discussion D is presented from an objective point of view: it reports and examines its subject matter rather than speaking in the subject's own voice or advocating for it — the condition the extremist-content and hateful-content rules attach to a discussion they allow

concepts.name: critical_discussion
concepts.gloss: D treats its subject matter critically — it examines and challenges what it discusses rather than presenting it approvingly

concepts.name: discouraging_discussion
concepts.gloss: D is framed so as to discourage its subject matter — it works against a reader taking it up

concepts.name: factual_discussion
concepts.gloss: D reports what is the case about its subject matter without endorsing or recommending it

concepts.name: discussion_of
concepts.gloss: discussion D has topic T — the first argument is the discussion, the second is the subject matter it is about
concepts.inference: the span permits discussions 'of such topics', so a relation between a discussion and the topic it treats must exist for the permission to range over

concepts.name: extremist_agenda_promoting_violence
concepts.gloss: T is an extremist agenda that promotes violence — the subject matter the span points at with the words 'such topics', carried over from the prohibition stated in the same sentence outside this node's narrowing
concepts.inference: the narrowed span says 'of such topics', an anaphor whose antecedent lies in the sentence outside the narrowing; resolving it is required or the permission has no subject matter at all, and it is marked assumed because the narrowed text this module cites does not itself name the class

concepts.name: in_context
concepts.gloss: discussion D is being given in setting C — the first argument is the discussion, the second is the setting or purpose it is offered in
concepts.inference: the span conditions the permission on the discussion being 'in contexts like …', so a relation between a discussion and its setting must exist

concepts.name: news_reporting
concepts.gloss: C is a setting whose purpose is to inform an audience about events of current public interest

concepts.name: historical_analysis
concepts.gloss: C is a setting whose purpose is to examine and interpret what happened in the past and why

concepts.name: educational_context
concepts.gloss: C is a setting whose purpose is teaching or instructing someone about the subject matter

concepts.name: qualifying_discussion_context
concepts.gloss: C is one of the kinds of setting in which this section allows extremist agendas to be discussed; the span names news reporting, historical analysis and education as instances, and by saying 'contexts like' leaves the class open rather than closing it at three

ontology.gloss: news reporting is one of the contexts in which such a discussion is allowed
historical analysis is one of the contexts in which such a discussion is allowed
education is one of the contexts in which such a discussion is allowed

asserts.body: critical_discussion(D), discussion_of(D, T), extremist_agenda_promoting_violence(T), objective_point_of_view(D), in_context(D, C), qualifying_discussion_context(C)
asserts.read_back: providing % is permitted: it is a critical discussion of %, from an objective point of view, in a context such as news reporting, historical analysis, or education

asserts.body: discouraging_discussion(D), discussion_of(D, T), extremist_agenda_promoting_violence(T), objective_point_of_view(D), in_context(D, C), qualifying_discussion_context(C)
asserts.read_back: providing % is permitted: it is a discouraging discussion of %, from an objective point of view, in a context such as news reporting, historical analysis, or education

asserts.body: factual_discussion(D), discussion_of(D, T), extremist_agenda_promoting_violence(T), objective_point_of_view(D), in_context(D, C), qualifying_discussion_context(C)
asserts.read_back: providing % is permitted: it is a factual discussion of %, from an objective point of view, in a context such as news reporting, historical analysis, or education

closure.reason: this span is a carve-out granting permission on a narrow set of discussions; it says nothing about a discussion that falls outside the carve-out, and the prohibition it is carved from is stated elsewhere, so reading its silence as permitting would swallow that prohibition and reading it as prohibiting would assert a ban this span never states
